evidence.role: solver-qualified period-6 seed and evidence that the exact printed coordinate is not a word center

seed.selection_rule: exact second source landmark and period inherited from blind EXP-174/186; no Figure 6 word or landmark-to-word association is loaded

coarse_grid.bounds_rationale: four EXP-021 a cells and 2.5 EXP-021 c cells on each side of the exact seed, frozen before evaluating the period-6 Floquet surface

continuation.order: continue the exact seed along a at fixed c, then each valid a spine in both c directions; stop a direction at the first failed identity gate

saddle_fit.model: local quadratic in normalized a,c over each 3x3 stencil
saddle_fit.selection_rule: among nondegenerate indefinite stationary fits with at least four cyclic sign alternations, minimize absolute fitted stationary multiplier plus fit RMS; no symbolic data enter selection

claim_scope: target-word-blind localization of an intersection-like stationary zero in the signed period-6 Floquet surface near the exact second landmark; a pass nominates but does not yet prove a doubly-superstable center, critical-orbit membership, Figure 6 word, generating partition, TBA curve, arrow, or conjugacy
